title: Wartime Rationing Day
hook: One egg a week and tea leaves dried twice.

scenes.text: During the Second World War in Britain, every single citizen carried a government-issued ration book.
scenes.imagePrompt: 1940s British brick high street with sandbags stacked outside shopfronts under grey sky. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos

scenes.text: Your weekly adult allowance was tiny: two ounces of butter, two ounces of tea, and one fresh egg.
scenes.imagePrompt: Kitchen wooden table with official ration coupons, a single egg, and tiny butter pat. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos

scenes.text: Housewives queued for hours outside grocers, unsure if meat or fruit would even be delivered.
